name: Aronica Plant Healthcare, LLC

hero.alt: Lush landscaped garden with a stepping-stone path, azaleas and mature trees

intro: Aronica Plant Healthcare has cared for Long Island trees, shrubs and lawns since 1990. Their certified arborists start with the soil, then build a custom program for each property, from tree and shrub spraying and deep root fertilization to pruning, lawn renovation and organic tick and mosquito control.

services.d: Spraying, deep root fertilization, anti-desiccant winter sprays and soil restoration.
Organic alternatives for ticks, fleas, mosquitoes and flying insects.
Conventional or organic fertilization, aeration, overseeding and lawn renovation.
Ornamental and mature tree pruning, air spading and tree support systems.
Emergency storm pruning, plus holiday lighting for the season.

why.d: They analyze your soil before building a program around what it needs.
ISA certified and NYS certified arborists on the job.
Plans tailored to your property, with ongoing monitoring.
Organic choices for lawns and for tick and mosquito control.
